//: Copy to aster.config.json and edit. Every key is optional - the app
//2: auto-detects a working setup and `python server.py --probe` tells you
//3: what it found. aster.config.json is gitignored.
//backend: auto tries http, then cli, then the built-in stub. Force one with http | cli | echo.
//http: Use this if Aster already listens on a port.

http.//style: auto picks openai for a chat/completions URL, else simple.

//cli: Use this if Aster is a command. The composed prompt goes in on stdin,
//cli2: the reply is read off stdout. null command auto-detects the Claude Code CLI.
//systemPrompt: Who Aster is. null uses the built-in one. The design sheet below
//systemPrompt2: is appended automatically, as is the render protocol when ComfyUI is up.

comfy.//model: null picks the first anime/illustration SDXL checkpoint ComfyUI reports.
comfy.//workflow: null uses the built-in SDXL text-to-image graph. For Flux, a LoRA,
comfy.//workflow2: or img2img, point this at an API-format workflow JSON using the

//renderPrefix: Style/character text put in front of every render prompt. A path to a
//renderPrefix2: *.txt file works too. null auto-finds an Aster *.txt prompt file.
//designSheet: Path to Aster's markdown design sheet, for chat context (not the sampler).
//designSheet2: null auto-finds an Aster *.md under ComfyUI-Shared\training or characters\.
